name: Sanjoy Banerjee
headline: Consulting Director Europe at Oracle
about:
With over 20 years of experience in IT consulting and product management, I am currently Consulting Director for Construction and Engineering Consulting Practice at Oracle, leading a team of project managers and consultants to deliver value-driven solutions for enterprise clients across Europe. I hold an MBA from IIM Bangalore and a PMP certification, demonstrating my strong academic and professional credentials.

My core competencies include digital transformation, program and product management, pre-sales, bid management, and business development. I have successfully implemented digital products and solutions in Construction and Engineering, SCM, Retail, and Utilities domains, and managed engagements with over $10 million annual revenue. I am passionate about helping clients achieve their strategic goals and vision through innovative and agile approaches.
… more

experiences.description:
Identifying and qualifying opportunities for the digital transformation program
 	Managing enterprise level digital transformation projects spanning all phases right from initiation to deployment
 	Interacting with multiple streams across technology & business functions, technology solutions providers & implementation partners for technology & business discussions, requirements analysis, solution development and implementation
 	Monitoring delivery management for technical deliverables of concurrent projects; understanding clients’ needs, requirements, and expectations and devising solutions accordingly
 	Partnering with senior stakeholders within the organization and the wider eco system of vendor partners & technology community
 	Accountable for meeting schedule, budget, quality and experience expectations for the projects
 	Renovating the organization model to achieve key business objectives such as enhanced quality focus, productivity improvement, seamless end-to-end management and integrated service capability
 	Spearheading initiatives to build future capabilities for digital expansions and building agile organization

Established Project Portfolio Management (PPM) Consulting Practice working in conjunction with the leadership

 	Managed multiple implementation projects for client organizations

 	Set-up Sales Enablement Project Management Office for Oracle PPM Global Business Unit (GBU)
 	Built cost-effective packaged solutions for fast track implementation of Oracle PPM products
 	Developed collaterals including brochures, flyers to assist the sales team
